name: application-timelines
title: Timelines
description: Chronological event list components for displaying activity feeds, project histories, audit logs, and company milestones in vertical and horizontal layouts.
useWhen: Showing a chronological log of events such as an order history, audit trail, or project activity feed.
Communicating a company's history or product roadmap where time ordering is the primary organizing principle.
Displaying onboarding progress or a sequence of completed and pending milestones.
avoidWhen: Events do not have a natural time ordering — use a list or table instead.
The number of events is very large and users need to filter or search — pair with pagination or virtualized list.
A step-by-step wizard flow is needed — use a stepper component that shows completion state more explicitly.
responsiveBehavior: Vertical timelines remain in a single-column layout at all widths. Horizontal timelines collapse to vertical on small viewports to prevent overflow. Middle-line vertical variants center the connector at wide widths but may left-align on mobile.
accessibility: Use a <ol> or <ul> list element for the timeline items so screen readers announce the count and list structure.
Time values should use the <time datetime='...'>  element with a machine-readable datetime attribute.
Decorative connector lines and dots must have aria-hidden='true' so they are not announced.

variants.title: Vertical
variants.description: Standard left-aligned vertical timeline with a connector line and event dots, suitable for activity feeds and audit logs.
accessibility: Timeline uses a list element; connector line is aria-hidden; time values use <time datetime>.

variants.title: Vertical (Dark)
variants.description: Left-aligned vertical timeline adapted for dark application surfaces such as dark dashboards or audit logs.
accessibility: Event text, timestamps, and connector dot colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Vertical with middle line
variants.description: Vertical timeline with alternating left/right event placement around a centered connector line — ideal for roadmaps, company histories, and milestone displays.
accessibility: Alternating layout is visual only; DOM order must follow chronological sequence for screen reader users.

variants.title: Vertical with middle line (Dark)
variants.description: Centered-connector alternating timeline adapted for dark surfaces, keeping both left and right event cards legible.
accessibility: Event card backgrounds and text on dark surfaces must maintain WCAG AA contrast on both sides of the center line.

variants.title: Horizontal
variants.description: Left-to-right horizontal timeline showing events along a horizontal track — best for product roadmaps, release histories, or onboarding phase summaries.
accessibility: Horizontal timeline wraps in an overflow container; DOM order follows left-to-right chronological sequence.

variants.title: Horizontal (Dark)
variants.description: Horizontal timeline adapted for dark surfaces, with track, dots, and event labels legible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Horizontal track color and event label text must meet contrast requirements against dark page backgrounds.
